targets.title: Predicting upcoming information in native-language and non-native-language auditory word recognition.
targets.evidence_quote: Experiment 2 was a web-based replication of a visual world experiment by Dijkgraaf et al. (2017).
targets.outcome_quote: Experiment 2 replicated the overall pattern observed in Dijkgraaf et al.’s original data (which was acquired in a lab-based setting): Participants tended to fixate earlier on a picture displaying the object argument if the verb was semantically constraining.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall-pattern replication verdict; the delayed measurement time course and smaller effect do not negate that verdict.

reasoning: New online sample retests the published predictive-processing finding. Experiment 1 is an instrument fixation task inspired by prior work, rather than a retest of a specific published finding. The original-data reanalysis supplies a comparison baseline.
